business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (in force)
Luxembourg-United States Double Taxation Convention (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 February 2019; CSSF Regulation 12-02; EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD4) and (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5) as transposed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of any foreign corporate shareholder
Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing the Luxembourg incorporation signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate board of the foreign shareholder / Process agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if country is non-Hague

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners and corporate officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notarial authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Association (statuts) in official company language (French preferred)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial deed (no apostille required for domestic notarial act)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of UBOs and directors against the Luxembourg FIU list, CSSF watchlist, EU CFSP financial sanctions, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list (for USD transactions), and domestic PEP registers. Risk classification follows CSSF AML/CFT circulars; low-risk standard commercial activity requires enhanced due diligence only if adverse media or geographic risk arises.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A corporate name must be expressed in Latin alphabet letters; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet with an officially certified transliteration. The name must be lawful, not contrary to public policy, and not misleading. A SARL must append either 'Société à responsabilité limitée' or the abbreviation 'SARL'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Luxembourg / Banque / Assurance / Banque Nationale (requiring prior ministerial authorization)
European, European Union, EU, Euro (suggesting EU institutional affiliation or monetary authority)
Fund, Funds, SICAV, FCP (requiring CSSF license or approval)
Clearing, Settlement, Depository (restricted financial infrastructure terms)
University, Académie, Ministère, Gouvernement (institutional or official-governmental terms)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS refuses a name registration, the incorporator may file an administrative appeal with the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice within 15 days of the refusal notice. The appeal must cite the legal basis of the name's distinctiveness and provide documentary evidence of prior use or trademark rights. If the refusal is based on a prohibited token, prior written authorization from the competent minister must be obtained before resubmission. A further judicial appeal lies with the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg within 3 months.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permitted as the registered seat of an SARL; the registered office must be a genuine address in Luxembourg where statutory records are accessible and administrative oversight is possible. Licensed commercial domiciliation agents may provide a registered office, but the company must retain effective management substance and a proportional physical footprint. For low-risk product distribution activities, this can be satisfied by a domiciliation contract plus local director/economic operator.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 10-15% annual likelihood of an RCS/CSSF administrative audit; unannounced on-site visits are common only when trade sanctions, adverse media, or tax compliance red flags arise. For a low-risk die-cast collectibles manufacturer, the standard expectation is a document-based inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence and drafting of articles of association, incorporation file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark / hourly or fixed-fee quote

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation and execution of the articles

Filing of UBO declaration with the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country competent apostille authority + certified translation provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular/Hague fee plus translation market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies (loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), as amended, notably Articles 1-9 (formation requirements), Title IV, Articles 179-192 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée); complemented by the Law of 19 December 2020 facilitating electronic filing and the Law of 13 January 2023 on the business registers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de commerce et des sociétés - RCS), operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) through the myRCS e-filing portal and the Guichet.lu single digital gateway.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) containing the articles of association (statuts), filed with the RCS by the Luxembourg notary and published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed capital of EUR 12,000 (approximately USD 13,200), which must be fully subscribed and fully paid up at incorporation in cash or in kind. Cash contributions must be deposited and irrevocably blocked in a credit institution account in Luxembourg or with a Luxembourg branch of a foreign bank, evidenced by a banker's certificate (attestation bancaire de blocage) lodged with the notary; in-kind contributions require a statutory auditor's report. Funds are released only after RCS registration is confirmed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the founders have subscribed to the entire share capital of EUR 12,000, and that full payment thereof has been made and acknowledged; (2) that the registered office be and is hereby established at the statutory seat indicated in the articles of association, within the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg; (3) that the corporate purpose, comprising the design, zinc alloy die-casting, tampo printing, assembly and distribution of 1:18 scale automotive replicas and collectibles, is approved; (4) that [insert name(s)] be and are hereby appointed as managers (gérants) with powers acting severally or jointly as set out in the statutes; and (5) that the managers are authorised to execute all RCS, VAT, social security, establishment, environmental and fire safety filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability verification and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - RCS name reservation desk, accessible via Guichet.lu or through the coordinating notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request listing at least two alternative corporate names; the proposed name must include 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or the acronym 'SARL', must not conflict with existing RCS entries, protected EU trademarks, or Luxembourg firm names, and must not be contrary to public order. The issued negative certificate (certificat de non-confusion) confirms availability for a limited statutory validity period, usually 40 calendar days, and binds the registry during the notarial drafting phase.
required_dossiers: Name reservation online form (Fiche de réservation de nom)
Proposed statutes or draft articles of association
Identity details of founding quotaholders
Statement of corporate purpose (ISIC 3240 - die-cast scale automotive models)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected for similarity, the representative must offer an alternative name from the priority list or add distinctive differentiating elements (	company suffix, trade mark reference, activity descriptor) and resubmit within the notice period; escalation to the LBR helpdesk or correction via the notary is available without reactivation fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of blocked capital deposit account and issuance of banker's certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institutions (e.g., Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État, BIL, Spuerkeess) or the Luxembourg branch of an EU/foreign bank; compliance with AML/KYC obligations supervised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate account in the intended company name for the purpose of capital subscription; transfer or remit the cash contribution of at least EUR 12,000 into the designated blocked account; instruct the bank to issue a formal blocking certificate (attestation de blocage de fonds) addressed to the notary, confirming availability of the funds and undertaking that withdrawals are prohibited until presentation of the RCS registration certificate. The certificate must reflect the corporate name and the exact amount subscribed.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association
Identity documents (passport/ID) and proof of residence for all quotaholders
Bank KYC forms, beneficial ownership declaration and source-of-funds documentation
Negative name certificate
Instruction letter to the bank for capital blocking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On additional KYC queries, provide supplementary bank statements or origin-of-funds evidence within the bank's deadline; if the initial institution declines the KYC file, approach a second Luxembourg bank cooperating with the notary and re-issue the blocking certificate; the bankers' attestation may be re-dated without notarial cost if the RCS registration is delayed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the notarial deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (Notaire luxembourgeois) appointed by the founders, exercising public authentication powers under the Law of 10 August 1915 and the Notarial Chamber regulations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary prepares the consolidated statutory text (statuts), performs anti-money laundering verification of all subscribing quotaholders, receives the banker's certificate of capital blocking, witnesses individual or collective signature of the deed of incorporation (acte constitutif), and immediately attests to the subscription and payment declarations. The deed must specify the corporate purpose confined to permitted industrial activity, the exact share division, form of shares, management powers, and the rules of majority for quotaholders' meetings.
required_dossiers: Valid certificate of non-confusion for the corporate name
Banker's capital blocking certificate
Personal identification and AML/KYC documentation of each quotaholder
Draft statutory articles with corporate governance clauses
Statement of subscription and payment of shares (déclaration de souscription et de versement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies deficiencies, the deed is corrected by preparing an additional clause or a rectification instrument (acte rectificatif) before signing; incomplete AML files delay execution and are cured by submitting compliant documentary evidence; the notary may require updated negative certificates if more than 40 days elapsed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - RCS statutory registrar, myRCS e-filing platform (e-justice portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary files the authentic deed together with the standard RCS registration forms (Formulaire F001 for company data and Formulaire F002 for authorised representatives) and evidence of payment of the registration fee; the registrar performs a substantive and formal legality review against the 1915 Law and, upon satisfaction, assigns the RCS number and the national identification number (numéro d'identification national - LV number), and issues the certificate of registration (certificat d'immatriculation).
required_dossiers: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation (statuts)
Form F001 - Company registration particulars
Form F002 - Directors/managers and authorised signatories
Banker's certificate of blocked capital
Receipt of the EUR 27 (approx. USD 30) registration fee plus RESA publication fee of EUR 19
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registrar issues a completeness or rectification request (demande de complément) within 15 working days; counsel responds electronically with corrected forms or supporting documents within the stated deadline; if the registrar declines registration, an acte rectificatif is executed by the notary and refiled; appeal against a substantive refusal lies with the Luxembourg administrative tribunal within three months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon completion of the RCS registration, the LBR automatically effects publication of the incorporation extract in RESA, including the company name, RCS number, registered office, share capital, managers and corporate purpose; the publication in RESA triggers the legal effectiveness of the incorporation vis-à-vis bona fide third parties and constitutes irrefutable evidence of the constitution date.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Authentic deed of incorporation
Standard RESA publication data sheet completed by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA extract contains inaccuracies or is delayed, the notary files a rectification (acte rectificatif) with the RCS which automatically re-publishes in RESA; late publication does not invalidate the company but third parties may invoke the deed against the company only after effective publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Value added tax (VAT) registration and issuance of Luxembourg VAT number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) - Bureau d'immatriculation des assujettis, Luxembourg City; filings via eTVA/MyGuichet.lu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the VAT registration application (Formulaire 700) within 30 days after RCS registration, declaring the effective start of the die-casting and retail/wholesale trade activity; the AEDT assigns a Luxembourg VAT identification number (country code LU) and validates the intra-Community operator status for EU trade; the company elects monthly or quarterly VAT returns depending on turnover thresholds and may apply the reverse-charge mechanism for B2B supplies of goods where applicable.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Form 700 VAT registration
Identity card of the gérants and authorised signatories
Description of activity: ISIC 3240 - manufacture of toys and scale models
Establishment authorization application reference (submission receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the AEDT demands supplementary information, respond within 15 calendar days via the single e-file; refusal or prolonged delay is appealed in writing to the Director of the AEDT within 15 days of notification; a provisional VAT number may be requested for urgent invoicing, subject to final validation of the file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer registration with the Luxembourg Social Security Centre
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS) - Register of employers, Luxembourg City.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SARL as an employer using the online 'Formulaire D' form no later than eight days before hiring the first worker; the CCSS assigns the employer's matriculation number, enabling the payment of social security contributions for factory and administrative employees, and coordinates with the health insurance funds (Caisse nationale de santé) and the labour accident insurance association (AAA).
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Employer registration form D
Identity details and matriculation of all current employees (if directed by CCCS)
Schedule of activities and premises address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration file is queried, correct and resubmit through the CCSS e-space within the notified period; retroactive employer liability is avoided by providing evidence that the file was lodged in due time; appeals against CCSS decisions are lodged with the social security tribunal (Conseil arbitral de la sécurité sociale) within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial establishment authorization (autorisation d'établissement) for manufacturing operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie - Direction générale des classes moyennes / Department of Establishment Authorizations, filings via Guichet.lu e-Form 'Établissement industriel et commercial'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the establishment authorization application for the commercial/artisanal activity of manufacturing die-cast scale models, including the industrial site address, managerial professional competence evidence (certificate of professional qualification for foundry/production management or appointment of a qualified manager), clean criminal record certificates (bulletin N3) of the managers, and particulars of the production equipment; the Ministry verifies compliance with the Law of 2 September 2011 on access to trades, issues the establishment authorization and registers it in the national business permit register.
required_dossiers: Establishment authorization application form (formulaire de demande d'autorisation d'établissement)
RCS registration certificate and RESA publication extract
Criminal record bulletins (casier judiciaire - bulletin N3) for each gérant
Evidence of professional qualification of the production manager
Lease agreement or property title for the factory and warehousing premises
Municipal zoning certificate (certificat d'affectation) confirming industrial land use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministerial department considers the file incomplete, deliver the additional documents within two months of the written query; refusal is preceded by an adversarial procedure and can be appealed within three months to the administrative tribunal; the manufacturing activity may only commence after the authorization is granted and, in case of imminent refusal, a provisional authorization with conditions can be requested.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie - Direction générale de l'industrie (Department of Industry) and Direction générale des classes moyennes (authorisation d'établissement); environmental supervision by the Administration de l'environnement; inspections by the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement - Establishment and Operating Permit for Industrial Manufacturing (covering zinc alloy die-casting, tampo printing, assembly and wholesale/retail trading of scale automotive models), issued by the Ministry of the Economy under the Law of 2 September 2011 on the regulation of access to artisan, commercial and industrial professions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environment Agency), under the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Classified installation (établissement classé) under the Luxembourg environmental classification regime (loi modifiée du 10 juin 1999 relative aux établissements classés). The zinc die-casting foundry (melting furnaces) and tampo printing line fall under Class 4 medium-risk category, requiring prior environmental authorization (commodo/incommodo) for operation; a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is triggered only for foundry melting capacity exceeding 4 tonnes per day, otherwise a simplified environment dossier with impact analysis suffices; the tampo printing VOC-emitting process requires a solvent management plan aligned with Chapter V of the EU Industrial Emissions Directive.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with EU Directive 2010/75/EU (Industrial Emissions Directive) and applicable BAT conclusions for non-ferrous metal foundries: dust emissions to air kept below 10 mg/Nm3 via bag-house filtration; VOCs from tampo printing solvents limited to 100 mg C/Nm3 in exhaust air; wastewater discharged to municipal sewer per the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 27 June 2001, with pH between 6.5 and 9.0 and maximum heavy metal concentrations of Zn 2 mg/l, Pb 0.5 mg/l, Cr 0.5 mg/l and Cd 0.1 mg/l; hazardous waste (solvent-containing residues, zinc slag) managed under the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management, including retention of tracking dossiers and disposal exclusively by licensed collectors.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.notes: A pre-construction environmental notification is mandatory where the facility is erected or modified; the environmental operating permit contains upstream monitoring obligations (annual emissions report, waste register and self-inspection plan).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and clearance issued by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS) including approved fire doors, extinguishing equipment, emergency exits, and an evacuation plan for the foundry floor; structural load and occupancy clearance from the competent municipal building authority (commune) under the modified Building Regulation of 26 May 2011 (ABRO/ABR); occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) covering machine guarding for die-casting presses, ventilation of fume and solvent areas, noise control measures below the 85 dB(A) exposure action value, provision of personal protective equipment for molten metal and ink handling, and medical surveillance of industrial employees; the ITM work permit (permis de travail santé et sécurité) must be obtained before commissioning of the production line.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxes and Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; both are accessible through the unified MyGuichet.lu taxpayer portal, with eTVA for VAT returns and EC Sales Lists, eCDF for corporate income tax and municipal business tax filings, and RCS-linked registration via guichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon notarial incorporation and registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS), the SARL automatically receives its 13-digit national identification number (matricule), which serves as the direct tax ID. VAT registration is then completed separately with the AEDT through the eTVA portal on Form 563, resulting in an LU+8-digit VAT identification number. A foreign entity not established in Luxembourg must register for VAT from its first taxable supply, with EU suppliers registering directly and non-EU suppliers appointing a fiscal representative (responsable solidaire) unless the reverse charge or OSS regime covers the supply.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SARL is a full resident corporate taxpayer with unlimited worldwide tax liability for corporate income tax (IRC at 17% plus 7% solidarity surcharge), municipal business tax (ICC) and net wealth tax; no pass-through treatment is available for a Luxembourg SARL.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Luxembourg; however, a SARL may elect fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) under Article 164bis LIR for subsidiaries at least 95% owned, join a VAT group under Article 60 LVD, and claim the participation exemption (10% shareholding or EUR 6 million acquisition cost plus a 12-month holding period) in its corporate income tax return. The passive Société de Participations Financières (SPF) regime is unavailable to an active die-casting manufacturer, and EU ATAD anti-hybrid rules apply mandatorily without elective opt-out.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis threshold applies: VAT registration is compulsory from the first euro for every person carrying out taxable supplies in Luxembourg. The only turnover-based relief is the Article 57 LVD small-business exemption (EUR 35,000 annual turnover) reserved exclusively for Luxembourg-established businesses. Cross-border B2C distance sales and electronically supplied services trigger Luxembourg registration or OSS filing once pan-Union turnover exceeds EUR 10,000; non-EU suppliers have no threshold and must register immediately.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg imposes no mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping or transaction-based clearance API as of the 2025 tax year; e-invoicing in EU-compliant formats is freely permitted. B2G invoices addressed to Luxembourg public administrations must be submitted in PEPPOL BIS format under EU Directive 2014/55/EU. VAT returns, VIES/EC Sales Lists and Intrastat declarations are filed electronically through the eTVA portal, and Luxembourg is preparing for the EU ViDA framework, which is expected to introduce mandatory e-invoicing and digital reporting in stages from the 2030s once adopted.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of zinc alloy die-cast scale models to non-EU destinations qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 53 LVD provided the goods physically leave the EU and the supplier substantiates that departure with transport documents within the customary audit benchmark of 90 days, extendable to 180 days for consolidated shipments. Intra-EU supplies qualify for zero-rating under Article 35 LVD when the customer holds a valid EU VAT ID and the goods are dispatched to another Member State. Export-related logistics and ancillary services rendered to non-EU customers are likewise zero-rated. A Luxembourg-established supplier or a locally appointed fiscal representative is a prerequisite for recovering any associated input VAT through the refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic SAD filed through the Luxembourg ECS/DEU export processing system)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing FX settlement of the export proceeds
Proof of Arrival in the destination market (customs-stamped delivery note or arrival certificate)
EC Sales List / VIES recapitulative statement containing the customer's valid EU VAT ID (for intra-EU supplies)
Intrastat Dispatch Declaration where applicable under the prevailing simplification threshold
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ACD/AEDT may reassess a claimed zero-rating within the standard five-year limitation period, extended to ten years where VAT fraud is established, and claw back the output VAT at the 17% standard rate plus monthly default interest of 0.6%. Documentary insufficiency alone, such as missing export stamps, bills of lading or remittance certificates, triggers retrospective reversal of the zero-rating without the need to prove intent. Administrative fines may reach 100% of the evaded tax, and criminal tax fraud under Article 397 of the General Tax Law is punishable by fines of up to EUR 25,000 and imprisonment of up to five years, with joint and several liability of management and any appointed fiscal representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), with Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as supervisory authority for credit institutions and payment services
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility under EU free movement of capital; no exchange controls or prior administrative authorizations apply to equity contributions, dividends, or trade-related payments; profit remittance is unrestricted subject to corporate formalities, bank-level sanctions screening, and anti-money laundering checks; the euro is the sole legal tender and all resident entities may transact in foreign currencies through licensed banks without central bank approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender or repatriation timeline exists; no mandatory conversion ratio into EUR applies; exporters may retain balances in foreign currency accounts at authorized Luxembourg credit institutions or route proceeds as commercially agreed, subject only to EU sanctions enforcement and KYC transaction monitoring.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account
Operational Current Account / Foreign Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: High for EU/EEA-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) operating in Luxembourg under the passporting regime of Directive 2009/110/EC; Low to Medium for offshore non-EU EMIs because they generally require a Luxembourg or EEA branch license and cannot rely solely on remote cross-border arrangements; non-EEA digital EMIs without a local passport or agent are legally unable to provide resident corporate accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance is not legally required under Luxembourg AML/CFT rules; remote onboarding may be completed using eIDAS-recognized electronic identification, video identity verification, and electronic signature solutions; however, banks retain the right to request a physical meeting or enhanced video interview with directors for entity formation validation, UBO verification, and source-of-funds clarification, especially when the corporate structure is multi-layered or includes non-EEA shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) ambiguity or inconsistencies in the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Matching-certified RBE registration extract, up-to-date constitutional deeds, notarized shareholder registers, complete ownership chain chart with percentage interests, and passport copies of every natural-person UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for the initial share capital contribution or subsequent equity injections
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letter from a reputable prior bank; audited financial statements of the direct parent; signed board and shareholder resolutions authorizing the capital transfer; bank statements showing the funding trail; and sworn declaration of the source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Elevated sanctions or politically exposed person (PEP) screening flags on directors, officers, or ultimate shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated and manual screening results, PEP ownership-flow analysis, substantial transaction rationale memorandum, adverse-media research file, and independent counsel legal opinion confirming that no EU/OFAC sanctions exposure exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicion of e-commerce or marketplace revenue mixing due to PayPal or online retailing of die-cast models
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed commercial agreements, pro-forma invoices and purchase orders, platform seller verification certificates, inventory records proving physical trade, and transaction-level projections that reconcile with the declared business model.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing is executed through the BCL/TARGET2 settlement layer using SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for equity injections; purpose codes must align with the EU Payment Services Directive and BCL balance-of-payments conventions: use 'P001' or 'S101' for foreign direct investment capital, 'P002' for reinvested earnings, or 'S601' for loans between non-residents and residents; the corresponding documentation (shareholder resolution, board capitalization memorandum, contract for equity contribution) must be pre-submitted to the receiving bank to prevent compliance holds; all wires are subject to EU/OFAC sanctions screening and FATF-recommended travel rule verification before credit to the capital escrow account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for die-cast mold tooling, zinc alloy, packaging, and freight use SWIFT MT103/MT202 COVER messages via high-value payment corridors; for conventional physical trade, commercial letters of credit (L/C at sight or with deferred payment) are issued through Luxembourg or confirming foreign banks, accompanied by full negotiation documents including commercial invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin, and inspection certificate; EU supplier payments can be executed via SEPA Instant Credit (SCT Inst) or the SEPA Credit Transfer scheme; FX conversion is performed only by authorized Luxembourg credit institutions at TARGET2-compliant SPOT and forward rates.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot EUR/USD and EUR/CAD transactions with BCL-regulated counterparties
Forward EUR/USD contracts with standard two-date settlement for trade receivables and payables
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/CNH or other non-fully-convertible currencies where permitted by Luxembourg prudential rules and counterparty credit policies
EUR/USD cross-currency interest rate swaps executed under ISDA master agreements with licensed investment firms
Protective EUR options (calls and puts on USD) and simple zero-premium forward collars
Currency swaps for long-term intercompany financing or capital structure optimization

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (Dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the financial year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 2,000 plus court-imposable amende civile; persistent non-filing triggers RCSL-initiated judicial dissolution or administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE - Luxembourg Business Registers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after the annual accounts approval; if no accounts required, within 15 months of the last RBE confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from EUR 300 to EUR 2,500 for non-compliance; intentional failure up to EUR 10,000 and/or imprisonment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Payment of annual RCSL file maintenance fee (cotisation annuelle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary as invoiced by the RCSL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Register file flagged as inactive; access to official RCSL extracts and certificates suspended until payment is made.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit required for SARL if it exceeds two of the following three criteria at the balance sheet date: total assets EUR 4.4 million; net turnover EUR 8.8 million; average workforce over 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Law of 19 December 2002 on annual accounts); optional IFRS for non-consolidated accounts only where explicitly permitted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must submit an annual confirmation to the RBE attesting the accuracy of recorded beneficial ownership. Any share transfer or ownership change must be reported to the RBE within 30 days of becoming aware, and the register of members updated immediately.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (register des partages et dirigeants)
Minute Book (procès-verbaux of shareholders' and board meetings)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box: 80% exemption on net qualifying IP income, reducing the aggregate Luxembourg City rate to approximately 4.99%; 100% participation exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains; enhanced investment tax credit on eligible new fixed assets. No general statutory tax holiday applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 500 (Déclaration d'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) filed through the ACD e-filing service accessible via MyGuichet.lu (Espace professionnel).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; accompanied by quarterly provisional corporate income tax payments based on the previous assessment or a tax ruling.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a financial year ending 31 December, the return must be filed by 31 December of the following calendar year. For a fiscal year ending on another date, the return must be filed by 31 December of the next calendar year. Extensions must be expressly granted by the ACD.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification: REN, registered office, NACE/ISIC sector, legal form, statutory representative, shareholder composition and amount of share capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must declare country of residence, tax identification number and attach a residence certificate where treaty relief is sought. A nominee shareholder must be identified as such.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial profit or loss per the annual accounts, reconciled with the balance sheet under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident related-party fees such as parent management charges, trademark royalties for scale model branding, and tooling royalties must be supported by written agreements and transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additions/reintegrations: non-deductible expenses, hidden profit distributions, excessive or undocumented intercompany charges, fines and penalties, and depreciation disallowed for CIT purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Charges invoiced by foreign affiliates are added back unless the foreign affiliate provides original invoices, proof of actual services, and an arm's length analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions: tax losses carried forward, participation exemption under Art. 166 LIR, IP box deduction under Art. 50bis LIR, notional interest deduction on eligible new equity, and investment tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received from non-resident and resident subsidiaries are exempt only if the participation conditions are met; attach beneficial ownership declarations and TRCs for foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after municipal business tax allocation among operating municipalities; application of the aggregate statutory rate of 24.94% in Luxembourg City.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders without a Luxembourg permanent establishment have no Luxembourg-sourced manufacturing income from this box; any sales commission attributed to a Luxembourg dependent agent must be included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits and prepayments: foreign tax credit, dividend withholding tax credits, tax prepayments, balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners attach Form 21 or equivalent TRC for withholding tax reclaims; a reimbursed withholding tax is itself treated as an additional dividend subject to CIT and municipal business tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an ACD reminder followed by an administrative fine of EUR 100 to EUR 10,000, an automatic 10% increase of the final CIT assessment, and collection interest at 3% per annum. In cases of gross negligence or intentional concealment, civil penalties range from 30% to 300% of the additional tax, with criminal referral for tax fraud.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% on gross dividends distributed by a Luxembourg SARL, unless reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for a parent holding at least 10% of share capital for 12 months, or reduced under an applicable double tax treaty (typically 5% to 15% for portfolio investors).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty relief, the non-resident beneficial owner must make a prior application to the Luxembourg ACD using the official withholding tax exemption/refund procedure. The applicant must submit a valid certificate of tax residence (Form 21/EU Annex III or bilateral TRC), evidence of beneficial ownership of the dividend, proof of shareholding, and, on request, documentation of economic substance. If the 15% was withheld at source, the beneficial owner may file a refund claim within the statutory 5-year limitation period; the Luxembourg paying company cannot retroactively apply the treaty rate without ACD acceptance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: no Luxembourg withholding tax on ordinary debt interest; profit-participating bonds are subject to a 15% withholding tax; treaty rates are generally 0% to 10%. Royalties: no statutory Luxembourg withholding tax on IP royalties paid to non-residents; the EU Interest and Royalties Directive applies at 0% for qualifying related companies. Payments to legal entities in EU-blacklisted non-cooperative jurisdictions may be subject to a 20% deduction at source under the domestic anti-abuse rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: CbC report mandatory for MNE groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000. There is no separate statutory monetary threshold for the Local File/Master File, but the ACD expects contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for any material related-party transaction upon request, generally to be submitted within 30 days of an audit demand.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg does not impose a standalone Economic Substance Regulations filing regime akin to offshore financial centres, but applies the OECD-aligned GAAR, ATAD substance-over-form jurisprudence, and permanent establishment case law. A Luxembourg SARL must demonstrate real registered office, local decision-making, adequate employees, and an actual business rationale. A letterbox entity using a shell structure to obtain treaty or EU directive benefits will be denied those benefits, and intragroup transactions may be recharacterized as hidden dividend distributions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of turnover from PayPal and SWIFT sales of die-cast scale models, fabrication of supplier invoices, false depreciation on die-casting tooling, and backdating of invoices to shift taxable income outside Luxembourg.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud under Art. 393-394 LIR: fine of EUR 1,250,000 or five times the evaded tax; imprisonment of up to 10 years for aggravating circumstances; civil tax increase of 30% to 300%; seizure of bank accounts and company assets; compulsory dissolution in exceptional cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations face criminal conviction, imprisonment, civil restitution of evaded tax and interest, personal liability for corporate tax debts where corporate assets are insufficient, and travel bans or exit restrictions pending criminal tax proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intra-group sales of 1:18 scale replicas below cost, paying excess brand royalties to an offshore intermediary without functional analysis, or failing to maintain contemporaneous Local File/Master File and CbC data.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Arm's length re-fixing by the ACD with upward adjustment of Luxembourg taxable income; 10% administrative increase; late-payment interest at 3% per annum; penalty of 30% to 50% of additional tax where records are missing; possible publication of tax arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly endorsed non-arm's length contracts are jointly and severally liable for the resulting additional CIT and interest; personal negligence claims under company law, professional disqualification, and criminal liability for false certification may follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SARL having only a registered mailbox address in Luxembourg, no personnel, no operational premises, board decisions taken remotely outside Luxembourg, and all substance located in Asia while profits are allocated to Luxembourg for treaty benefit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of Luxembourg tax residence; denial of participation exemption and IP box; denial of treaty and EU directive benefits; recharacterization of payments as undisclosed dividends subject to 15% withholding tax; penalties and interest on reassessed tax; possible cancellation of the commercial register registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be stripped of limited liability where the entity is a mere sham; courts may impose civil restitution for diverted funds, personal payment of unreported WHT, travel bans while fraud investigations are active, and imprisonment for abuse of company law.
